messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00036:
Huh?
Are you a newcomer, too?We had to recruit new members for the
Radio Tower mission. Then we ran out of uniforms.I heard this studio has some, so I
decided to “borrow” one.Since you are here, why don’t you
change as well?
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00037: Look at you! Pretty good!\rOh, but you shouldn’t try to scare\npeople walking around looking\flike that, OK?
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00039:
Ooh, your Pokémon are so very
charming! How enchanting!If you dress up your Pokémon here,
make it a sight to behold!Then I will even hang a picture of one
in the other room!You will do this, won’t you? {YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00040: Oh, you silly thing...\nWhere’s your sense of adventure?
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00041: Ooh, ooh, yes! How nice!\nLet’s not delay!\rShould I explain to you how\nto dress up your Pokémon? {YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00042: Ooh, I wonder which Pokémon you’ll\ndress up?\r
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00043: Teeheehee...\nI hope you will dress it up adorably!\r
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00044:
You have a Fashion Case, don’t you?
Ah, oui, wonderful!Just choose the Accessories and put
them on your Pokémon.When you’re done, I will snap a photo
and put it up beside me!If you mix your records with others,
you can get their photos, too!I think it will be much easier if 
you will just try! {YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00045: Ooh, nice work!\nLet’s display the photo right away!\fOh, but it needs to have a title!\r
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00046: {STRVAR_1 28, 0, 0}...\rOoh, yes, yes! I get it now!\nYour aesthetics shine through!\r
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00047: Oh, non, non, non!\nIt will be forlorn without a title.\r
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00048: Oh... You came out without doing\nanything... How disappointing.
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00049: If you dress up any Pokémon again,\nthe photo here will be changed.\rWould you like to dress up\na Pokémon, dearie? {YESNO 0}
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00050: Why don’t I dress up myself and hang a\npicture...?\rThe title should be...\nHmm...how about “Girl’s Paradise”?
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00051: Ooh, non, non, non! That’s an Egg!\nIt’s too young to be dressing up!\r
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00052: I put your photo up right here.\nIt just looks so perfect there!
messages.msg_0117_D37R0102_00053: It’s a frame for holding a\nportrait photo.
